title: File:Boris Pistorius German Minister of Defense and German Ambassador to the United States Andreas Michaelis visits Arlington National Cemetery, Virginia on May 8, 2024 - 6.png
desc: German Minister of Defense Boris Pistorius and German Ambassador to the U.S. Andreas Michaelis visit Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, Va., May 8, 2024. While at ANC, Pistorius participated in a Public Wreath-Laying Ceremony at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. (U.S. Army photo by Abigail Carey
